patterns.text: New constraint: MUST:     MAGIC defines the triad interface directly:
New constraint: MUST:     Read governed config at runtime (no baked constants)
New constraint: MUST:     Keep repo boundaries explicit (submodules only inside ROOT)
New constraint: MUST:     Inherit from SHOP
New constraint: # LOCAL_PATH must use ~ and be a direct path (no globs).
New constraint: 3. MUST expose economic views that bridge WORK = COIN (SHOP view; VAULT view)
New constraint: MUST:     Canonical projection artifact is `~/.canonic/SERVICES/GENERATOR/services-manifest.json`
New constraint: MUST:     Service->fleet mapping is a direct projection from governed `DEXTER/SHOP/SERVICES/**/CANON
New constraint: CANONIC scopes MUST remain decomposable in the filesystem (composition by directories).
New constraint: MUST:     Every post MUST be IP-safe (no kernel, no bits, no dimensions)
New constraint: MUST:     DESIGN.css template + DESIGN.js shared across fleet
New constraint: MUST:     Keep kernel internals non-public in governed interfaces
New constraint: MUST:     top nav = CANONIC root axioms + one common TALK button (all sites)
canonic-canonic is the infrastructure layer. DEXTER and ROBERT registered as USERs. Orgs build on infra, users govern orgs.
ROBERT_FLATTEN applied to runner-canonic. Same pattern as DEXTER_FLATTEN on hadleylab-canonic. The repo IS the principal, everyone else is a USER.
runner-canonic registered as GOV repo in CANONIC.git. Three GOV repos: canonic-canonic (infra), hadleylab-canonic (Dexter's org), runner-canonic (Robert's org).
13 hardening gates absorbed into governed ROADMAPs. 4 CLOSED (architecture + Ed25519), 9 OPEN (crypto, econ, pipeline). Gov first: roadmap before implementation.
